BM25 filter works during multi-page crawl, keeping relevant pages

```elixir title="Elixir"
engine_config = "{\"bm25_query\":\"rust programming\",\"bm25_threshold\":0.1,\"content_filter\":\"bm25\",\"max_concurrent\":1,\"max_depth\":1}"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.crawl_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.pages, 0).html)
```
